Employee.title: Employee
Employee.description: Represents a crew member in the payroll system.

name.description: The full name of the employee.

hourlyRate.description: The base hourly rate for the employee.

onTimeBonus.description: The hourly bonus rate if the employee clocks in on time.

rules.description: Custom payroll rules for the employee.

TimeEntry.title: TimeEntry
TimeEntry.description: Represents a single clock-in/clock-out event for an employee.

employeeId.description: The ID of the employee this time entry belongs to.

clockIn.description: The timestamp when the employee clocked in.

clockOut.description: The timestamp when the employee clocked out.

date.description: The date of the time entry.

/timeEntries/{timeEntryId}.description: Stores all time clock-in and clock-out entries.
